intent.raw: Research if there is prior art on this, and we are not just restating.
intent.objective: Run an adversarial prior-art and novelty audit over the Craft translation-entropy / SCU-U-curve / measurement-design claim bundle, searching external literature and local sources to mark each claim restatement, partial-overlap, or novel-synthesis, and converge on an honest statement of what (if anything) is novel, without promoting canonical Arcanum or Craft authority.
intent.operator_sentence: Default to assuming we are restating known work; only call something novel if a specific, citable gap in the prior art survives an adversarial search.

route_menu.context_hint: The audit can be prosecutorial (assume restatement) or generous (assume novelty). The prosecutorial route is selected to avoid motivated novelty claims.

items.label: Prosecutorial full-mode fanout
items.description: Assume restatement; fan out six lanes to find the closest prior work for each claim; require a specific surviving gap before any novelty verdict.

items.label: Single lane: bias-variance only
items.description: Only check whether the U-curve is bias-variance/double-descent restated; fastest but ignores MDL, semantic entropy, decomposition, and SE evidence.

items.label: Novelty-first drafting
items.description: Draft a novelty claim then look for support; rejected as motivated-reasoning-prone, recorded for contrast only.

technique_overlays.trigger: Attractive claim bundles are most often restatements under new vocabulary, so the audit must default to restatement and demand a cited surviving gap for any novelty.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every claim is marked restatement, partial-overlap, or novel-synthesis with a citation; a novel-synthesis mark must name the specific gap the cited art leaves.

technique_overlays.trigger: The audit relies on external web literature that must not silently become canonical Arcanum knowledge.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: External sources are flagged protected context, remain candidate, and cannot be promoted to canonical vocabulary from this audit.

steps.name: Extract the exact claims to audit for prior art
stop_conditions: Block if the refine result and definition card cannot be read.
Flag if a claim cannot be stated crisply enough to search against.

steps.name: Define the prior-art search lanes
convergence_criteria: Each lane maps to one or more claims and names the literature it must search.
Lanes cover bias-variance, MDL/bottleneck, semantic entropy, decomposition/long-context, functorial inversion, and empirical unit-size evidence.
Each lane has a closing mark vocabulary: restatement, partial-overlap, novel-synthesis.
stop_conditions: Block if any audited claim has no lane.
Flag if two lanes are indistinguishable in their search targets.

steps.name: Run full-mode lane-by-lane prior-art search
convergence_criteria: Each lane returns the closest prior work with a citation or URL.
Each lane marks each assigned claim restatement, partial-overlap, or novel-synthesis.
Any novel-synthesis mark names the specific gap the cited art leaves.
No lane promotes glossary, ontology, sigil, spell, or Craft-definition authority.
stop_conditions: Block until the operator approves delegated full-mode web search subagents.
Block a novelty verdict that lacks a cited disconfirming search.
Flag any claim whose literature cannot be reached and record it as missing-source residue.

steps.name: Adjudicate restatement vs novelty
convergence_criteria: The prosecutor preserves the restatement reading and the defender the novelty reading until synthesis.
Each claim C1-C8 gets one verdict: restatement, partial-overlap, or novel-synthesis with a cited gap.
The overall verdict states plainly whether the bundle is novel synthesis, narrow novelty, or restatement.
No verdict claims novelty without a surviving, cited gap.
stop_conditions: Block if the synthesis edits CRAFT-INITIAL-DEFINITION.md instead of producing a verdict card.
Block any novelty claim that the prosecutor refutes with a single citation.
Flag if the defender cannot name any gap and the verdict is forced to full restatement.

steps.name: Validate the audit route and record open residue
convergence_criteria: Each restatement and each surviving novelty gap names a next object.
Unreached literature is recorded as missing-source residue.
stop_conditions: Flag if open residue lacks an owner or next route.

steps.name: Prepare candidate-only novelty handoff
stop_conditions: Defer any positioning or publication claim until the novelty verdict is owner-reviewed.
Ask operator approval before treating any novelty claim as established.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The claim bundle spans six distinct literatures (bias-variance, MDL/bottleneck, semantic entropy, decomposition/long-context, functorial inversion, empirical unit-size) that need independent web search to avoid one reviewer's familiarity bias deciding novelty.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Role-bound sibling searchers keep each literature independent so a restatement in one field is not missed because another field looks novel, and a final dialectic adversarially adjudicates the marks.
context: The refine run produced an attractive bundle; attractive bundles are the most likely to be restatements under new vocabulary.
Each literature has its own venues and terminology that a single searcher would under-cover.

roles.purpose: Find whether the U-curve / interior-minimum claim is bias-variance or double descent restated.
Find whether SCU-as-minimizer and spread-vs-fidelity are MDL, rate-distortion, or information-bottleneck restated.
Find whether semantic-cluster entropy of LLM outputs is already established uncertainty quantification.
Find whether optimal task-decomposition granularity and long-context decay are already studied for LLMs.
Find whether schema/data/residue as functorial Bayesian inversion is already covered by the tower's literature and Spivak.
Find whether optimal work-unit size minimizing defects/residue is established software-engineering or agent-decomposition evidence.
Argue every claim is prior art and refute novelty marks with citations.
Argue for the narrowest defensible surviving novelty gap, or concede restatement.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the prior-art audit fanout across six literature lanes with web search, then an adversarial restatement-vs-novelty dialectic, returning cited prior-art receipts and per-claim verdicts only?
receipt_requirements: closest prior work with citation or URL
per-claim mark: restatement, partial-overlap, or novel-synthesis with surviving gap

agents.residue: partial-overlap; Wu 2025 CoT-length U is the closest threat; full text unparsed (see R-PA4).
restatement; C2/C3 are Rissanen two-part code + information bottleneck.
restatement; proxy A is literally Kuhn/Farquhar semantic entropy.
partial-overlap; RAG granularity already shows interior optimum; task-unit optimum open.
restatement, no gap; tower already imports Spivak/Cho-Jacobs/St Clere Smithe.
partial-overlap; diff-size optimum solid, module-size contested (El Emam/Koru), see R-PA3.
narrowest survivor = r* codebook-invariance + blind-rubric co-location protocol, not the U-curve.
Protocol novelty collapsed: NML gives codebook-invariance by construction; stability selection + multiverse + convergent validity cover the rest.
Axis novelty collapsed: Wu 2025 model is axis-agnostic; translation-unit size relabels their N.
Module-size U is likely a spurious-ratio artifact (El Emam/Koru); drop it, restrict C8 to diff-size + LLM-subtask.

boundaries.contract: Lane prior-art receipts feed the adjudication dialectic as candidate evidence; they do not by themselves settle novelty.
External web sources are protected context: cited and summarized, never promoted into canonical Arcanum vocabulary.
The novelty verdict is a candidate reading until the Craft definition owner reviews any positioning or publication claim.

state_namespaces.write_policy: This audit may write only under research/autobayes.
External sources are referenced and summarized only; no canonical promotion from this audit.

promotion_splits.source: research/autobayes prior-art receipts and novelty verdict
promotion_splits.target: canonical Craft definition, Arcanum glossary, or any novelty/publication claim
promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review and a separate promotion route

gates.condition: Each audited claim must be stated crisply enough to search the literature against, distinguishing the Craft framing from the underlying formal object.
Every audited claim must be assigned to a lane and return a closest prior work with a citation, or be recorded as missing-source residue.
Recommended full-mode web-search subagents require explicit operator approval before delegated search runs.
A novel-synthesis verdict must name a specific gap the cited prior art leaves; any novelty claim refuted by a single citation must be downgraded to restatement or partial-overlap.
External web sources are protected context and must not be promoted into canonical Arcanum glossary, ontology, sigil, spell, or the Craft definition.
The dispatch must pass formulae/dispatch-spec/scripts/validate-dispatch.py before being treated as handoff-ready.

promotion_guardrails: Do not call any claim novel without an adversarial disconfirming search and a specific surviving gap.
Do not promote prior-art findings or the novelty verdict into canonical Arcanum glossary, ontology, sigil, spell, or the Craft definition.
Do not let one familiar literature decide novelty for a claim that belongs to another field.
Do not treat external web sources as source-closed until they are actually read, not just retrieved by title.
Do not execute the web-search subagents without explicit operator approval.
